newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Macquarie Bank appoints Brunei director.
newsitem.headline: Macquarie Bank appoints Brunei director.

text.p: Australia's Macquarie Bank Ltd has appointed a representative of its largest shareholder, the Brunei Investment Agency (BIA), to its board, Macquarie executive chairman David Clarke said on Wednesday.
BIA managing director Pehin Aziz Abdul Rahman has been appointed a non-executive voting director, Clarke said in a statement.
The appointments bring the Macquarie Bank board's membership to 10 from nine, he said.
The BIA became Macquarie Bank's largest shareholder in November 1996 when it purchased 13.4 percent of the bank's, shares from Lloyds TSB Plc's Hill Samuel subsidiary.
